content.title: Mock test dena hai?
content.subtitle: Mock sirf score dekhne ke liye nahi, galtiyan pakadne ke liye hai.

steps.title: Asli test jaisa mahaul
steps.detail: Timer lagao, phone door rakho, ek baar mein poora test. Beech mein break nahi.

steps.title: Galtiyan likho
steps.detail: Har galat answer ke saamne likho kyun galat hua. Time, vocab ya samajh.

steps.title: Pattern dhoondo
steps.detail: Ek hi type ki galti baar baar? Asli kaam wahi hai.
steps.tip: IELTS kit ka Failure Patterns tab isi ke liye hai.

steps.title: Weak section pe focus
steps.detail: Sab kuch dobara mat padho. Jahan marks ja rahe hain, wahan time do.

steps.title: Phir se mock
steps.detail: Kuch din practice ke baad agla mock. Farak khud dikhega.
steps.tip: IELTS kit mein free full mock hai, sign up karke.

caption:
Mock test diya, score dekha, aage badh gaye? Aise mat karo. Mock ka sahi tareeka 👇

1. Asli test jaisa mahaul
2. Galtiyan likho
3. Pattern dhoondo
4. Weak section pe focus
5. Phir se mock
